name: Acura NSX FE-BZ
description:
Acura NSX FE by BZ SimWorks:

The Acura NSX Special Edition is based on the new NSX, with an imposing body kit designed by Turn10 team and improved by BZ SimWorks, with some changes and new elements like the new aerodinamic components.
The engine is the same V6 used by the stock NSX. It has two new turbos replacing the factory ones, and some elements like the exhaust system have been redesigned. No hybrid and electric parts present now, and the torque is aplied to the rear tyres only.
All these modiffications and some heavy elements replacement make posible a vehicle mass redution of at least 300kg, giving it a new level of dynamics and behavior.

Two versions; base and track aero kits.
author: BZ SimWorks (Beto FR & Zorro GSi)
